Item No. 2024.AC6.1: Introduction of all the members of Academic Council. 
Resolution: 
The Chairman, Academic Council extended warm welcome to all the Academic Council members. 
Item No. 2024.AC6.2: Action Taken Report on Minutes of 5th Academic Council Meeting 
Resolution: 
The Chairman, Academic Council appraised the members about the resolutions / suggestions made 
during the 5th Meeting of Academic Council held on 23rd September, 2023 and presented the action 
taken as detailed below. 
 The Course Structure and syllabi of III and IV B.Tech. (I and II Semesters) for CSC and 
CSD programmes (R20 Regulations) were successfully implemented during the AY         
2023-24. 
 SVCE R23 Academic Regulations, Course Structure and Syllabi of I Year (I and II Semesters) 
B.Tech. programmes were successfully implemented during the AY 2023-24. 
 Measures were taken to send IV B.Tech. II Semester students for full semester Internship 
to the maximum extent wherever it is possible. 
 A credited course on Entrepreneurship will be considered in the next curriculum revision. 
 Measures were taken to offer more electives. 
 More MOOC courses will be considered in the next curriculum revision. 
 Sufficient measures were taken to place students who were not placed on campus through 
off campus placements. 
 Measures were taken to acknowledge the students who have done the best community 
service projects. 
 Appropriate steps were taken to encourage and guide students to write research papers, 
improve the quality of projects. 
 CO-PO mapping in the Basic Civil and Mechanical Course of I B.Tech. (R23 Regulations) is 
done with thorough verification. 
 Successfully conducted a hands-on experience training to I B.Tech. students on vehicle 
design / product design by local experts. 
Item No. 2024.AC6.3: To consider the nomination of ONE subject expert to the BOS 
of each department by the Hon’ble Vice-Chancellor of JNTUA, Ananthapuramu. 
Resolution: 
The members have taken note of the nomination of one subject expe rt to the BOS of each 
department by the Hon’ble Vice Chancellor of JNTUA, Ananthapuramu (ANNEXURE - I). 
Item No. 2024.AC6.4:  
(i) To nominate TWO subject experts from outside the parent university from the 
panel submitted by the Principal, SVCE to the BOS of each faculty by the 
academic council. 
Resolution: 
 The Chairman, Academic Council presented the panel of experts from outside the 
parent university to the Academic Council members for nominating TWO  subject 
experts from each Department.

 The members nominated TWO subject experts for each Department from outside the 
parent university (ANNEXURE - II). 
(ii) To nominate ONE expert from the Industry from the panel submitted by the 
Principal, SVCE to the BOS of each faculty by the academic council. 
Resolution: 
 The Chairman, Academic Council presented the panel of Industry expert s to the 
Academic Council members for nominating ONE expert for each Department. 
 The members nominated ONE expert from the Industry for each Depar tment 
(ANNEXURE - III). 
(iii) To nominate ONE meritorious Alumnus from the panel submitted by the 
Principal, SVCE to the BOS of each faculty by the academic council. 
Resolution: 
 The Chairman, Academic Council presented the proposed panel of meritorious alumni 
to the Academic Council members for nominating ONE expert for each Department.  
 The members nominated ONE meritorious alumnus for each Department  
(ANNEXURE - IV). 
Item No. 2024.AC6.5: Exemption from Credit Based Detention for the AY 2024-25 
Resolution: 
 The Chairman, Academic Council proposed the exemption of students from credit 
based detention and promote all the students from II to III year and III to IV year 
B.Tech. programmes for the AY 2024-25 in SVCE in line with JNTUA circular wide No. 
Lr. No. JNTUA/DAPO/Exemption from credit based detention/2024, Dated :01-08-
2024 (ANNEXURE - V). 
 The members approved the proposed exemption from credit based detention in SVCE 
for AY 2024-25. 
Item No. 2024.AC6.6: Academic Calendars for the AY 2024-25 
Resolution: 
 The Chairman, Academic Council proposed the Academic Calendars of I, II, III, an d 
IV B.Tech. for the AY 2024-25, following the guidelines of UGC/ AICTE/JNTUA, 
Ananthapuramu to the Academic Council members. 
 The members approved the proposed Academic Calendars of I, II, III, and IV B.Tech. 
for the AY 2024-25. 
The members also authorized the Chairman, Academic Council to approve and implement the 
Academic Calendars for any programme as and when they are finalized. 
Item No. 2024.AC6.7: Suggestions from Hon’ble Members of Academic Council 
Resolution: 
 The Chairman, Academic Council has sought suggestions from the members to 
enhance the overall development of the institution.  
 The Hon’ble Members expressed their appreciation for the measures initiated by the 
college since the last meeting to improve the academics standards of the college. 
 The Hon’ble Members shared their valuable suggestions as mentioned here under:

extent

consideration
